comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening limit; PR-1151 purges air from a syringe while preserving liquid and returns it to a rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires tool seating, threaded countertorque and articulated verification; PR-1151 requires orienting a fluid-filled syringe, stabilizing its barrel and regulating plunger travel.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate measures retained angle, drift, nut retention and cycle function; PR-1151 measures residual air, liquid loss, safe pose, release and a continuous endpoint hold.
comparison.reason: Fluid-preserving plunger control is meaningfully different from mechanical stop adjustment and locknut counterholding; all spec revisions provide sufficient rubric detail.
